title: Project supported legacy mix-table events into GP8 automation
scope: Translate supported beat-local instrument, tempo, volume and balance changes into equivalent target events; classify other controllers individually.
acceptance: Use a legacy beat with simultaneous tempo, program, volume and balance changes at a nonzero position.
Preserve timing and event order while avoiding duplicates with score/track automation collections.
For chorus, reverb, phaser, tremolo and transitions, implement a verified wire mapping or retain an exact per-controller omission.
exclusions: Do not synthesize audio or implement proprietary RSE processing.

reproduction.instructions: Use a legacy beat with simultaneous tempo, program, volume and balance changes at a nonzero position.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
